title: Cloud installs keep the hand-off start-up hooks, or say why not
why: Finding, Oct 27 23:11 CDT (an audit session's report, relayed in cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh23uGo4eqsUrqqbGKYMctN3n): install.sh near line 632 makes a cloud install replace every start-up hook with the refresh hook, so cloud sessions lose the hand-off hooks.
note: Debt, ruled a defect by the lane (Oct 28): no decision record covers it, and install.sh's "stays hook-free" comment predates the SessionStart hooks in settings.json. Fix: append the refresh hook to the repo's SessionStart list; red then green in hooks/test_install_src.sh. Green and reviewed: draft PR #726, head 9f5ab95 (Opus builder, Opus reviewer round 1 clear); waits for the next batch. Known false-red: cloud_settings1 if settings.json ever lacks a SessionStart key (fix: .hooks.SessionStart // []). Ties to c54 part 3 (install claude-settings in cloud containers). Needs no answer. Port: no; install.sh lives here. Placed ahead of c82 (triage, Oct 28): every cloud session may lose its hand-off.
